gap: No result ChatGPT got prices each station together with its maker's own home-hookup hardware. Priced that way at maker stores on 2026-11-15, BLUETTI's Apex 300 + B300K + Home Backup Kit costs $3,199 for 5,529.6 Wh (about $0.58/Wh). The Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus can only be bought from Anker as a $4,799.99 Smart Home Power Kit bundle for 3,840 Wh (about $1.25/Wh), because the station alone is sold out.
standout_why: I compared three cited rivals. StormWatts (cited) gives $/kWh for three stations from Oct 14 sale prices but says hardwiring needs a transfer switch or inlet and prices none of them. EnergySage (cited) has station or panel-bundle prices with no dates and no hookup-hardware prices. It also lists the F3800 Plus at $4,879.99 without saying what that price includes. Offset Solar (cited) gives $/Wh at undated 'MSRP/street' prices and names the Smart Home Panel 3 and transfer switches without prices. None of them notes that the F3800 Plus alone, the DELTA Pro 3 alone and the original DELTA Pro Ultra are sold out at their makers' stores, or that the Explorer 5000 Plus is on pre-order. TheOutagePlan (cited) would not open because of an SSL certificate error, so I did not compare against it.
decides: For someone who wants home circuits backed up (the 'transfer switch or home panel' ChatGPT tells shoppers to add), the cheapest 120/240 V system I could buy in stock with its maker's hookup kit is BLUETTI Apex 300 + B300K + Home Backup Kit at $3,199 for 5.5 kWh. That supports pointing shoppers to our listed bundle (slug bluetti-apex-300-b300k-home-backup-kit-single) over ChatGPT's picks. The F3800 Plus loses on price: today it only comes as a $4,799.99 kit, not ChatGPT's '$2,400–$3,000'. The Explorer 5000 Plus loses on availability: it is a $3,499 pre-order shipping Nov 28, and its $1,299 Smart Transfer Switch is sold out. The DELTA Pro Ultra inverter is out of stock at EcoFlow. The DELTA Pro Ultra X is the only in-stock whole-home option at 12 kWh, but it starts at $7,899 before any panel. With the $3,299 Smart Home Panel 3 the Smart Control Kit is $10,899.
